description: This file manages a project slider component with AJAX loading, filtering, and responsive behavior, including initialization, destruction, and event handling for a project showcase.

methods.name: setSlideVisibility
methods.description: Adjusts opacity of visible slides and hides partial slides to improve rendering.

methods.name: destroySlickProjects
methods.description: Destroys the slick slider instance, ignoring errors if already destroyed.

methods.name: initSlickProjects
methods.description: Initializes the slick slider with specific settings and event handlers for slide changes and lazy loading.

methods.name: drawProjects
methods.description: Reloads project slides via AJAX based on filter and location parameters, rebuilding the slider.
